evidence_quote: The Thorold Community Market Grand Finale is scheduled for Saturday September 5 from 12:00 to 4:00 p.m. This is a free event located in Battle of Beaverdams Park. ... The Thorold Community Market will open at 5 p.m.
notes_en: Mixed community market rather than a producer-only farmers' market. The City page does not state the regular closing time or the season start/end dates and does not state a year; the Thorold BIA advertises "Every Wednesday Evening starting June 11th - September 3rd (weather permitting)" (https://thoroldbia.com/pages/community-market-car-show), which is not the municipal source and is not dated by year, so season fields are left null.
notes_fr: Marche communautaire mixte plutot que marche fermier de producteurs. La page municipale n'indique ni l'heure de fermeture ni les dates de saison; les dates de la BIA ne sont pas datees par annee, donc les champs de saison restent nuls.
